column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah E99016: Zimmerman & Cocoon membereskan internal Orlog,
# lalu George Gore dan Karl Holtz kabur dari pembersihan konglomerat.
# Tetap Inggris: Cecht FABN, Orlog Financial Conglomerate, Lullaby, Cocoon, Zimmerman,
# Doll, Tactical Doll, Frame, Boojum, URNC, Statesec, NOMFA, Bureau 11, Mangi Security,
# Lentine, Mokosh, P.M.C., The Elmo, Commander, Dandelion, Heli, Medquinn, Mede,
# George, Karl, Agatha, Lonnie, Pawel, White/Green/Yellow Zone, Golden Fleece,
# Frankfurt, New Venice, Paradeus, Purification Engineering Department.
# "Your Excellency" -> "Tuan" (Cocoon menyapa Zimmerman), mengikuti gaya naskah 05.

(The airlock door slid silently to the side, welcoming the identity-verified visitor. The elegant and beautiful third-generation Doll gracefully stepped into the luxurious and spacious office with impeccable strides, only to run right into two disheveled-looking men—)
column2: (Pintu airlock meluncur ke samping tanpa suara, menyambut tamu yang identitasnya sudah diverifikasi. Doll generasi ketiga yang elegan dan cantik itu melangkah masuk ke ruang kerja luas dan mewah itu dengan langkah tanpa cela, hanya untuk berhadapan langsung dengan dua pria berpenampilan kusut—)

column1: (They were all executives of Cecht FABN, yet at this moment, they looked as if they were about to flee in panic.)
column2: (Keduanya eksekutif Cecht FABN, tapi saat ini mereka tampak seperti hendak kabur karena panik.)

column1: Oh my—did your chat not go well, gentlemen?
column2: Aduh—apa pembicaraan kalian tidak berjalan lancar, Tuan-tuan?

column1: Ugh, this isn't something you should be asking about! A mere Doll...
column2: Ugh, ini bukan urusan yang boleh kau tanyakan! Cuma seorang Doll...

column1: Do not forget your place!
column2: Jangan lupa posisimu!

column1: Yes, I have overstepped.
column2: Ya, saya lancang.

column1: (Cocoon stepped aside and bowed her head with perfect etiquette.)
column2: (Cocoon menyingkir ke samping dan menundukkan kepala dengan etiket sempurna.)

column1: (Behind the huge desk made of ebony and carbon-titanium fiber in the center of the office, a deep but highly penetrating voice sounded at the right time, like a long whip making the two keep quiet out of fear.)
column2: (Di belakang meja raksasa dari kayu eboni dan serat karbon-titanium di tengah ruangan, sebuah suara dalam namun sangat menusuk terdengar tepat pada waktunya, seperti cambuk panjang yang membuat keduanya bungkam karena takut.)

column1: Do you two still have time to complain about this kind of thing? If it weren't for her alertness, intercepting your communication in time—you two would have caused major losses to Cecht FABN, and even the entire Orlog Financial Conglomerate. I think you should harbor some gratitude.
column2: Kalian berdua masih punya waktu mengeluhkan hal seperti ini? Kalau bukan karena kewaspadaannya, yang mencegat komunikasi kalian tepat waktu—kalian berdua sudah menimbulkan kerugian besar bagi Cecht FABN, bahkan bagi seluruh Orlog Financial Conglomerate. Menurutku kalian seharusnya menyimpan sedikit rasa terima kasih.

column1: Ah, yes, yes, the Chief is right to teach us a lesson...
column2: Ah, ya, ya, Chief benar memberi kami pelajaran...

column1: Miss Cocoon, thank you very much for your support.
column2: Miss Cocoon, terima kasih banyak atas bantuanmu.

column1: (The third-generation Doll humbly responded to the insincere pleasantries. Cocoon watched the two walk away, the flickering light and shadow in her eyes indicating that things would not end so simply.)
column2: (Doll generasi ketiga itu menanggapi keramahan yang tidak tulus itu dengan rendah hati. Cocoon memperhatikan keduanya menjauh, kelip cahaya dan bayang di matanya menandakan urusan ini tidak akan berakhir sesederhana itu.)

column1: (Then, she turned her attention to the person monopolizing this huge office, prioritizing important work.)
column2: (Lalu, dia mengalihkan perhatiannya kepada orang yang memonopoli ruang kerja raksasa ini, mendahulukan pekerjaan penting.)

column1: Your Excellency, those "proposals" related to Lullaby received from within Cecht FABN have been processed.
column2: Tuan, "proposal" terkait Lullaby yang masuk dari dalam Cecht FABN sudah selesai diproses.

column1: There are 257 in total, but only 3 have reference value. Would you like to take a look?
column2: Totalnya 257, tapi hanya 3 yang punya nilai rujukan. Mau Anda lihat?

column1: No need. At this point in time, any action we take will be seen by the other families.
column2: Tidak perlu. Di titik waktu ini, tindakan apa pun yang kita ambil akan terlihat oleh keluarga-keluarga lain.

column1: Lullaby has only achieved preliminary results, and there are still many subsequent steps that need to be ensured to progress smoothly—but in the eyes of the short-sighted, this is already the time they can't wait to "harvest".
column2: Lullaby baru membuahkan hasil awal, dan masih banyak langkah lanjutan yang harus dipastikan berjalan mulus—tapi di mata orang berpandangan pendek, ini sudah waktunya mereka tak sabar untuk "memanen".

column1: (Zimmerman's gaze fell on the door opened by the two people he had driven away not long ago.)
column2: (Tatapan Zimmerman jatuh ke pintu yang baru saja dibuka dua orang yang dia usir tadi.)

column1: (They were the "short-sighted people" he spoke of, who, under the guise of considering the interests of Cecht FABN, couldn't wait to stretch out their greedy hands, eager to share the grace of victory.)
column2: (Mereka itulah "orang berpandangan pendek" yang dia maksud, yang dengan kedok memikirkan kepentingan Cecht FABN, tak sabar mengulurkan tangan rakusnya, ingin ikut menikmati berkah kemenangan.)

column1: These people mistakenly thought the lullaby was a short-term trick to hypnotize the dragon so they could steal the Golden Fleece. They completely failed to understand how much power they now hold in their hands, and how this power should be used.
column2: Orang-orang ini salah menyangka lullaby itu cuma trik jangka pendek untuk menghipnotis naga agar mereka bisa mencuri Golden Fleece. Mereka sama sekali tidak paham sebesar apa kekuatan yang kini ada di tangan mereka, dan bagaimana kekuatan itu seharusnya dipakai.

column1: It seems that before taking the next step, we should first do some cleaning up within Orlog.
column2: Sepertinya sebelum melangkah lebih jauh, kita harus bersih-bersih dulu di dalam Orlog.

column1: I'm ready. Do you want them to disappear, or "persuade" them?
column2: Saya siap. Anda ingin mereka hilang, atau "dibujuk"?

column1: Plucking them out one by one will be endless. Keep a close watch first, then scatter some bait to gather them together before dealing with them.
column2: Mencabuti mereka satu per satu tidak akan ada habisnya. Awasi ketat dulu, lalu sebar umpan supaya mereka berkumpul sebelum diurus sekaligus.

column1: Yes, hehe, I didn't expect that compared to controlling the situation, you prioritized dealing with internal problems...
column2: Baik, hehe, saya tidak menyangka dibanding mengendalikan situasi, Anda lebih dulu membereskan masalah internal...

column1: The URNC is too massive to swallow in one bite—sadly, Orlog is just as bloated and corrupt. The seats of the six major families are not all given to those who deserve them. We must eliminate the possibility of incompetent people touching powerful weapons.
column2: URNC terlalu besar untuk ditelan sekali suap—sayangnya, Orlog sama gembung dan korupnya. Kursi enam keluarga besar itu tidak semuanya jatuh ke tangan yang pantas. Kita harus menghapus kemungkinan orang tak cakap menyentuh senjata sebesar itu.

column1: The lifting of the P.M.C. firepower control act and the development rights for heavy weapons. With just these two achievements, Orlog has gained countless benefits and occupied an advantageous seat within the URNC. If anyone is still unsatisfied, that's just personal insatiable greed.
column2: Pencabutan undang-undang pembatasan daya tembak P.M.C. dan hak pengembangan senjata berat. Hanya dengan dua pencapaian itu, Orlog sudah meraup keuntungan tak terhitung dan menempati kursi menguntungkan di dalam URNC. Kalau masih ada yang tidak puas, itu cuma keserakahan pribadi yang tak pernah kenyang.

column1: Unfortunately, even if you show such huge results, it won't stop the other families from getting restless. At the next meeting, they will unite and demand that Cecht FABN yield more power.
column2: Sayangnya, sebesar apa pun hasil yang Anda tunjukkan, itu tidak akan menghentikan keluarga lain jadi gelisah. Di rapat berikutnya mereka akan bersatu dan menuntut Cecht FABN menyerahkan lebih banyak kuasa.

column1: How long can the third-generation Dolls maintain activity?
column2: Berapa lama Doll generasi ketiga bisa tetap aktif?

column1: (Facing Cocoon's hint, Zimmerman did not show anxiety. After a slight ponder, he asked a seemingly completely unrelated question.)
column2: (Menghadapi sindiran Cocoon, Zimmerman tidak menunjukkan kecemasan. Setelah berpikir sejenak, dia melempar pertanyaan yang tampak sama sekali tidak berkaitan.)

column1: (Cocoon blinked, showing a look of surprise, but couldn't find a reason to refuse to answer either.)
column2: (Cocoon mengerjap, menunjukkan wajah terkejut, tapi tidak menemukan alasan untuk menolak menjawab.)

column1: If the Boojum pronucleus cells are stable and the Frame can be maintained and updated on time, Mother believes that theoretically we can continue to be active for over a thousand years.
column2: Kalau sel pronukleus Boojum stabil dan Frame bisa dirawat serta diperbarui tepat waktu, Mother percaya secara teori kami bisa terus aktif lebih dari seribu tahun.

column1: Humans don't have such a long lifespan, so many people are anxious to achieve their goals before they die.
column2: Manusia tidak punya umur sepanjang itu, jadi banyak orang tak sabar mencapai tujuannya sebelum mati.

column1: Five years, ten years, twenty years—even I will have my own time limit.
column2: Lima tahun, sepuluh tahun, dua puluh tahun—aku pun punya batas waktuku sendiri.

column1: If we are to achieve our ideals, patience is a necessary virtue—I will remind them of this.
column2: Kalau ingin mewujudkan cita-cita kita, kesabaran adalah keutamaan yang wajib—aku akan mengingatkan mereka soal itu.

column1: Please note that hostile actions against you will become increasingly obvious.
column2: Mohon dicatat, tindakan permusuhan terhadap Anda akan makin terbuka.

column1: And within the URNC—especially Statesec—investigations into you have not stopped.
column2: Dan di dalam URNC—terutama Statesec—penyelidikan terhadap Anda belum berhenti.

column1: If you fall into a predicament, things won't go so smoothly.
column2: Kalau Anda sampai terjebak, semuanya tidak akan berjalan mulus.

column1: It's fine, as long as you do your job well, they won't find an opportunity.
column2: Tidak masalah, selama kau bekerja dengan baik, mereka tidak akan dapat celah.

column1: On this point, you can be completely assured... almost.
column2: Soal itu, Anda bisa sepenuhnya tenang... hampir sepenuhnya.

column1: (Cocoon rarely spoke with reservation, which caught Zimmerman's attention.)
column2: (Cocoon jarang berbicara setengah-setengah, dan itu menarik perhatian Zimmerman.)

column1: (Obviously, the third-generation Doll harbored some doubts in her heart at this moment.)
column2: (Jelas, Doll generasi ketiga itu sedang menyimpan keraguan di hatinya.)

column1: It seems you've discovered something again.
column2: Sepertinya kau menemukan sesuatu lagi.

column1: Yes, Your Excellency. In my communication with Heli and the retrieval of classified documents, I found a name... the true name of the AI I encountered not long ago on that Commander's "The Elmo"—
column2: Benar, Tuan. Dalam komunikasi saya dengan Heli dan penarikan dokumen rahasia, saya menemukan sebuah nama... nama sejati AI yang saya jumpai belum lama ini di "The Elmo" milik Commander itu—

column1: Her name is "Dandelion".
column2: Namanya "Dandelion".

column1: In terms of electronic warfare, she is undoubtedly the strongest existence I have ever met. I think, compared to Heli, she is a greater threat.
column2: Dalam perang elektronik, dia tidak diragukan eksistensi terkuat yang pernah saya jumpai. Menurut saya, dibanding Heli, dia ancaman yang lebih besar.

column1: Are you saying that this AI, hidden deeper than Heli, is the one truly making decisions for the URNC?
column2: Maksudmu AI ini, yang tersembunyi lebih dalam dari Heli, adalah yang sebenarnya mengambil keputusan untuk URNC?

column1: Her actual role within the URNC remains to be discovered. Considering she can appear remotely on The Elmo, I think she doesn't need to constantly bear the function of macro decision-making like Heli does.
column2: Peran sesungguhnya di dalam URNC masih perlu digali. Mengingat dia bisa hadir dari jauh di The Elmo, menurut saya dia tidak perlu terus-menerus memegang fungsi pengambilan keputusan makro seperti Heli.

column1: It's just that... if "Dandelion" starts to act, it's still possible to recapture Heli. I have already asked the research team to prepare countermeasures for this.
column2: Hanya saja... kalau "Dandelion" mulai bergerak, Heli masih mungkin diambil kembali. Saya sudah meminta tim riset menyiapkan penangkalnya.

column1: In addition, Dandelion's existence also shows that the "Commander" probably still maintains contact with many big shots within the URNC all along. Many of his actions also have the "tacit approval" of the URNC higher-ups behind them.
column2: Selain itu, keberadaan Dandelion juga menunjukkan "Commander" itu kemungkinan sejak awal masih menjaga kontak dengan banyak orang besar di dalam URNC. Banyak tindakannya juga punya "restu diam-diam" dari kalangan atas URNC di belakangnya.

column1: My "Mother" also once said that you and the Financial Conglomerate both underestimate that person too much.
column2: Mother saya juga pernah bilang bahwa Anda dan konglomerat sama-sama terlalu meremehkan orang itu.

column1: Oh, "she" said that too?
column2: Oh, "dia" juga bilang begitu?

column1: Then what is your view?
column2: Lalu bagaimana pandanganmu?

column1: That person... perhaps, has some charm.
column2: Orang itu... mungkin, punya pesona tersendiri.

column1: (Zimmerman noticed that Cocoon seemed to admit it very reluctantly and unwillingly.)
column2: (Zimmerman menyadari Cocoon mengakui itu dengan sangat berat hati dan enggan.)

column1: (She placed her hand on her chest, calming her emotions with a human-like gesture.)
column2: (Dia menempelkan tangan ke dadanya, menenangkan emosinya dengan gestur yang sangat manusiawi.)

column1: He is neither a chess player nor a chess piece, but someone who wants to subvert the game and overturn the chessboard. He is destined to be the rule-breaker you hate the most.
column2: Dia bukan pemain catur, bukan pula bidak, tapi orang yang ingin menjungkirkan permainannya sekalian membalik papannya. Dia sudah ditakdirkan jadi pelanggar aturan yang paling Anda benci.

column1: There have been quite a few mistakes in the judgment of him so far...
column2: Sudah cukup banyak kesalahan dalam menilai dia sejauh ini...

column1: Then, it seems the military operations Mangi Security is about to carry out will encounter unexpected resistance.
column2: Kalau begitu, sepertinya operasi militer yang segera dijalankan Mangi Security akan menemui perlawanan yang tak terduga.

column1: Indeed. NOMFA, Statesec... and the overseas Bureau 11, multiple departments have expressed strong stances.
column2: Benar. NOMFA, Statesec... dan Bureau 11 di luar negeri, beberapa departemen sudah menyatakan sikap keras.

column1: At least in public, the military is forbidden from entering the game, and the combat can only be completed by Mangi Security and other P.M.C.s.
column2: Setidaknya di depan publik, militer dilarang turun ke arena, dan pertempurannya hanya boleh diselesaikan Mangi Security serta P.M.C. lain.

column1: So, you're not optimistic about the military operations Adjutant Lentine and Mangi Security are about to launch?
column2: Jadi, kau tidak optimistis dengan operasi militer yang segera dilancarkan Adjutant Lentine dan Mangi Security?

column1: No matter how many times the tactical deduction is performed, I can't see any possibility of victory for that 'Commander'—
column2: Berapa kali pun deduksi taktis dijalankan, saya tidak melihat satu pun peluang kemenangan bagi 'Commander' itu—

column1: But, if he is the hero of Frankfurt who once destroyed Paradeus, perhaps... there will be a turning point in this battle.
column2: Tapi, kalau dia benar sang pahlawan Frankfurt yang pernah menghancurkan Paradeus, mungkin... akan ada titik balik di pertempuran ini.

column1: Whether Mangi Security loses or wins, the conglomerate will be the winner.
column2: Mangi Security kalah atau menang, konglomerat tetap jadi pemenangnya.

column1: As for that Commander, if he really can win, we'll formulate countermeasures against him when the time comes.
column2: Soal Commander itu, kalau dia benar-benar bisa menang, kita susun penangkalnya saat waktunya tiba.

column1: However, in my opinion, he has no chance—after all, it's not just Mangi Security and a mere Lentine participating in the operation.
column2: Namun menurutku dia tidak punya peluang—lagi pula bukan cuma Mangi Security dan seorang Lentine yang terlibat di operasi itu.

column1: Even if the military is not allowed to intervene, that woman always has a way.
column2: Meski militer tidak boleh ikut campur, perempuan itu selalu punya cara.

column1: Since we already know that Commander is also a favored person, what about the background of the other "friend" we met in New Venice this time?
column2: Karena kita sudah tahu Commander juga orang yang diistimewakan, bagaimana dengan latar belakang "kawan" lain yang kita temui di New Venice kali ini?

column1: Regarding the investigation of Councilor Medquinn... hehe, he should be called 'Minister' now, it went very smoothly.
column2: Soal penyelidikan Councilor Medquinn... hehe, sekarang dia harus dipanggil 'Minister', semuanya berjalan sangat mulus.

column1: As you expected, being able to get promoted after this incident is not only because of merits, but also because—this was a position intended for him from the start.
column2: Seperti dugaan Anda, dia bisa naik jabatan setelah insiden ini bukan cuma karena jasanya, tapi juga karena—kursi itu memang sejak awal disiapkan untuknya.

column1: Minister of the Purification Engineering Department?
column2: Minister dari Purification Engineering Department?

column1: Exactly, there is a detailed explanation in this report, you will understand once you take a look.
column2: Tepat, ada penjelasan rincinya di laporan ini, Anda akan paham begitu melihatnya.

column1: (Cocoon handed the terminal over, and Zimmerman's gaze was quickly drawn to it.)
column2: (Cocoon menyerahkan terminalnya, dan tatapan Zimmerman langsung tersedot ke sana.)

column1: (The political achievements and merits of the person in front of him were too dazzling for a young URNC bureaucrat—and what was even more dazzling was not just this resume.)
column2: (Pencapaian politik dan jasa orang di hadapannya terlalu mencolok untuk seorang birokrat muda URNC—dan yang lebih mencolok lagi bukan cuma riwayat itu.)

column1: He is—that person's...?
column2: Dia—orang itu...?

column1: Indeed, I have verified it. This is not a deliberately concealed secret, and it is not difficult to verify.
column2: Benar, saya sudah memverifikasinya. Ini bukan rahasia yang sengaja disembunyikan, dan tidak sulit dipastikan.

column1: Then, we need to change our countermeasures and arrange an opportunity to meet him. I want to personally confirm the threat he can pose.
column2: Kalau begitu, kita perlu mengubah penangkalnya dan mengatur kesempatan untuk menemuinya. Aku ingin memastikan sendiri seberapa besar ancaman yang bisa dia timbulkan.

column1: Yes, Your Excellency.
column2: Baik, Tuan.

column1: Ah, right, there's one more small matter... It might take up your time, but I think it's necessary for you to hear it.
column2: Ah, benar, ada satu hal kecil lagi... Mungkin memakan waktu Anda, tapi saya rasa perlu Anda dengar.

column1: I trust your judgment, go ahead and say it.
column2: Aku percaya penilaianmu, katakan saja.

column1: Do you remember the former first leader of Mokosh named 'George Gore', and Karl Holtz, these two people?
column2: Anda masih ingat mantan pemimpin pertama Mokosh bernama 'George Gore', dan Karl Holtz, dua orang itu?

column1: These two losers, the memories associated with them aren't very pleasant. Can't the URNC's prisons even hold trash like this?
column2: Dua pecundang itu, ingatan yang berkaitan dengan mereka tidak menyenangkan. Penjara URNC bahkan tidak sanggup menahan sampah seperti itu?

column1: I received news that someone seems to have bailed them out, and... it's very likely through Mede's network.
column2: Saya menerima kabar sepertinya ada yang menebus mereka, dan... sangat mungkin lewat jaringan Mede.

column1: Now, in order to protect themselves, they might say some things that are very detrimental to you and FABN...
column2: Sekarang, demi menyelamatkan diri, mereka mungkin mengatakan hal-hal yang sangat merugikan Anda dan FABN...

column1: Under the current situation, such people will emerge endlessly. Clean them up according to the plan.
column2: Dalam situasi sekarang, orang-orang seperti itu akan muncul tanpa habisnya. Bereskan mereka sesuai rencana.

column1: (Zimmerman shrugged without a moment's hesitation.)
column2: (Zimmerman mengangkat bahu tanpa ragu sedetik pun.)

column1: (His gaze remained on the materials related to Mede, showing not the slightest interest in such nobodies.)
column2: (Tatapannya tetap tertuju ke materi soal Mede, tanpa minat sedikit pun pada orang-orang tak penting itu.)

column1: As you wish, Mr. Zimmerman.
column2: Sesuai kehendak Anda, Mr. Zimmerman.

column1: Lullaby has already sounded, please give me a week to complete these preparations.
column2: Lullaby sudah berbunyi, beri saya waktu seminggu untuk menyelesaikan persiapan ini.

column1: A week... heh. I imagine that over the course of this week, there will emerge quite a few moments worthy of being recorded in history.
column2: Seminggu... heh. Kubayangkan dalam seminggu itu akan muncul cukup banyak momen yang layak dicatat dalam sejarah.

column1: I hope the history of later generations can fairly evaluate everything we have done.
column2: Saya berharap sejarah generasi mendatang bisa menilai adil semua yang kita lakukan.

column1: (By Green Zone standards, this room looks cramped and cluttered no matter how you look at it. The space of less than ten square meters is piled high with opened food packaging and all sorts of garbage.)
column2: (Dengan standar Green Zone, kamar ini sempit dan berantakan dari sudut mana pun dilihat. Ruang kurang dari sepuluh meter persegi itu menumpuk tinggi bungkus makanan terbuka dan segala macam sampah.)

column1: (After cramming in two unkempt men—with unshaven beards and days' worth of accumulated body odor—this place successfully transformed into a desperate prison cell, forcing them to huddle in their respective corners as far away from each other as possible.)
column2: (Setelah dijejali dua pria acak-acakan—brewok belum dicukur dan bau badan bertumpuk berhari-hari—tempat ini sukses berubah menjadi sel penjara yang bikin putus asa, memaksa mereka meringkuk di sudutnya masing-masing sejauh mungkin dari yang lain.)

column1: (The eyes they stared at each other with were bloodshot, signs of sleep deprivation and overly excited and tense energy. Undoubtedly, this place would only increase their hostility and wariness towards each other.)
column2: (Mata yang mereka pakai untuk saling menatap memerah, tanda kurang tidur dan energi yang terlalu tegang. Tidak diragukan, tempat ini hanya menambah permusuhan dan kewaspadaan mereka satu sama lain.)

column1: (But after being cut off from the outside world for a long time, they were each other's only conversation partners—)
column2: (Tapi setelah lama terputus dari dunia luar, mereka satu-satunya lawan bicara bagi satu sama lain—)

column1: (And it was precisely because of this factor that Karl ultimately didn't stab George to death with a fork, and George also gave up the idea of hanging Karl with a shoelace.)
column2: (Justru karena faktor itulah Karl akhirnya tidak menusuk George sampai mati dengan garpu, dan George juga membatalkan niat menggantung Karl pakai tali sepatu.)

column1: What about the person you know? The one who can take us to escape to the White Zone?
column2: Bagaimana dengan kenalanmu itu? Yang bisa membawa kita kabur ke White Zone?

column1: Young master, are you too unfamiliar with the rules of this line of work? They will contact us after everything is arranged. Professionals, trustworthy.
column2: Tuan muda, kau terlalu asing dengan aturan di dunia ini? Mereka akan menghubungi kita setelah semuanya diatur. Profesional, bisa dipercaya.

column1: On the contrary, this "safe house" of yours, is the pocket money your rich dad gives you really this little?
column2: Malah sebaliknya, "safe house" milikmu ini, uang jajan dari ayahmu yang kaya itu benar-benar cuma sekecil ini?

column1: This was originally prepared for myself!
column2: Ini aslinya kusiapkan untuk diriku sendiri!

column1: It's all because of you that the supplies have been exhausted. You'd better prove your usefulness to me right now, otherwise I will definitely eliminate you!
column2: Persediaannya habis semua gara-gara kau. Sebaiknya kau buktikan sekarang bahwa kau berguna bagiku, kalau tidak aku pasti melenyapkanmu!

column1: No wonder it's all children's snacks...
column2: Pantas isinya jajanan anak-anak semua...

column1: As for our situation, blame me? Isn't it all because of that woman—she lost contact after calling us over. I think she must have been taken out.
column2: Soal keadaan kita, mau menyalahkan aku? Bukannya ini semua gara-gara perempuan itu—dia hilang kontak setelah memanggil kita. Kurasa dia sudah dihabisi.

column1: What about Lonnie, can't he provide us with protection?
column2: Bagaimana dengan Lonnie, dia tidak bisa memberi kita perlindungan?

column1: He's busy rushing back to Mangi Security to scramble for profits. The URNC lifted the Firearm Control Act, and that woman named Lentine has been making a huge splash. It's impossible for him to obediently listen to Agatha.
column2: Dia sibuk balik ke Mangi Security buat berebut keuntungan. URNC mencabut Firearm Control Act, dan perempuan bernama Lentine itu sedang bikin gebrakan besar. Mustahil dia mau menurut pada Agatha.

column1: Hehe, I wonder if Agatha recruited him too. If it really is the worst-case scenario we envisioned, I guess it'll be his first time dying—Mr. Zimmerman absolutely won't tolerate a P.M.C. threatening him.
column2: Hehe, entah Agatha merekrut dia juga atau tidak. Kalau ini benar-benar skenario terburuk yang kita bayangkan, kurasa itu bakal jadi kematian pertamanya—Mr. Zimmerman sama sekali tidak akan membiarkan satu P.M.C. mengancamnya.

column1: (George gave a bitter smile. There wasn't much schadenfreude in his tone, rather, at this moment he only felt sympathy for a fellow sufferer.)
column2: (George tersenyum pahit. Tidak banyak rasa senang atas kesusahan orang lain dalam nadanya, justru saat ini dia hanya merasa senasib.)

column1: (Even curled up in this safe house cut off from external communication, he knew that the Financial Conglomerate was now rising for a second time like the midday sun, and had a deeper interest binding with the military through the development license for heavy armaments.)
column2: (Bahkan sambil meringkuk di safe house yang terputus dari komunikasi luar, dia tahu konglomerat kini naik untuk kedua kalinya bagai matahari tengah hari, dan punya ikatan kepentingan yang lebih dalam dengan militer melalui lisensi pengembangan persenjataan berat.)

column1: (The possibility Agatha once claimed—of tripping up Zimmerman—was now completely invisible.)
column2: (Kemungkinan yang dulu diklaim Agatha—menjatuhkan Zimmerman—sekarang sama sekali tidak terlihat.)

column1: Speaking of Lentine, I heard Mangi Security is going to make a move on Mokosh.
column2: Ngomong-ngomong soal Lentine, kudengar Mangi Security akan bergerak ke Mokosh.

column1: Do you have any thoughts?
column2: Ada pendapat?

column1: (Noticing Karl's malicious teasing smile, George spread his hands.)
column2: (Melihat senyum meledek Karl yang penuh niat jahil, George membentangkan kedua tangannya.)

column1: Maybe that woman won't get her way so smoothly this time.
column2: Mungkin kali ini perempuan itu tidak akan semulus itu mendapatkan maunya.

column1: The people of Mokosh are very familiar with war, they won't lose so easily.
column2: Orang-orang Mokosh sangat akrab dengan perang, mereka tidak akan kalah dengan mudah.

column1: Before I was kicked out, I paid a large tribute to the Financial Conglomerate every year in exchange for a bunch of medieval weapons. I think those old employees won't be too disappointing even if I, the boss, am gone, right?
column2: Sebelum aku diusir, tiap tahun aku menyetor upeti besar ke konglomerat demi setumpuk senjata zaman batu. Kurasa para pegawai lama itu tidak akan terlalu mengecewakan meski aku, bosnya, sudah tidak ada, kan?

column1: ...You're actually this calm, consider me offended.
column2: ...Kau setenang ini ternyata, anggap saja aku tersinggung.

column1: Rather than wasting emotions on old matters, it's better to plan for the future early.
column2: Daripada membuang emosi untuk urusan lama, lebih baik cepat merancang masa depan.

column1: We only said some inconsequential things, which doesn't count as posing a threat to Mr. Zimmerman and the Financial Conglomerate. There is still room for maneuver in everything. As long as we can find some news he would be interested in, maybe we can survive.
column2: Kita cuma mengatakan hal-hal yang tidak penting, itu belum terhitung mengancam Mr. Zimmerman dan konglomerat. Segalanya masih ada ruang untuk bermanuver. Selama kita bisa menemukan kabar yang menarik minatnya, mungkin kita bisa bertahan hidup.

column1: You mean, switch camps again?
column2: Maksudmu, pindah kubu lagi?

column1: Who else could it be?
column2: Memangnya ada pilihan lain?

column1: (To George's frankness, Karl didn't display the agitation and unease he had anticipated; instead, he suddenly became very calm.)
column2: (Menghadapi keterbukaan George, Karl tidak menunjukkan kegusaran dan kegelisahan yang dia perkirakan; sebaliknya, dia tiba-tiba jadi sangat tenang.)

column1: (This kind of emotion was very unfamiliar to George. The look Karl gave him actually contained a hint of pity.)
column2: (Emosi semacam itu sangat asing bagi George. Tatapan Karl kepadanya justru mengandung sedikit rasa kasihan.)

column1: So, that woman told you nothing... and you still agreed to help her?
column2: Jadi, perempuan itu tidak memberitahumu apa pun... dan kau tetap mau membantunya?

column1: The power behind her.
column2: Kekuatan di belakangnya.

column1: ...Does she really have power behind her?
column2: ...Dia benar-benar punya kekuatan di belakangnya?

column1: Is she really a young lady from a big family in the White Zone!?
column2: Dia benar-benar nona dari keluarga besar di White Zone!?

column1: How is that possible!? That kind of speech and behavior clearly doesn't come from the White Zone.
column2: Mana mungkin!? Cara bicara dan tingkahnya jelas bukan dari White Zone.

column1: Yeah, she's like me, has a smell of being dug out from the dirt of the Yellow Zone. But since she's pretending so hard, it's not good to expose her... You mean, she really has her own backing?
column2: Iya, dia seperti aku, tercium bau habis digali dari lumpur Yellow Zone. Tapi karena dia berlagak sekeras itu, tidak baik membongkarnya... Maksudmu, dia benar-benar punya penyokong sendiri?

column1: Calling it a backer isn't quite right, but she is indeed working for powerful people, otherwise why would I listen to a lower-class person...
column2: Menyebutnya penyokong tidak terlalu tepat, tapi dia memang bekerja untuk orang-orang berkuasa, kalau tidak kenapa aku mau mendengarkan orang kelas bawah...

column1: (Karl cut off his words and glanced at George.)
column2: (Karl memotong kata-katanya sendiri dan melirik George.)

column1: No other meaning intended.
column2: Tidak ada maksud lain.

column1: I keep a record of others' offenses in my notebook, you continue.
column2: Aku mencatat kelakuan buruk orang di buku catatanku, silakan lanjut.

column1: Who is her backer?
column2: Siapa penyokongnya?

column1: A destined big shot. He himself is not a high-ranking official, but he is highly regarded by many bigwigs... Anyway, I don't plan to go back to the Financial Conglomerate.
column2: Orang besar yang sudah ditakdirkan. Dia sendiri bukan pejabat tinggi, tapi sangat dihargai banyak orang penting... Pokoknya aku tidak berniat kembali ke konglomerat.

column1: Cecht FABN has been very smooth recently, but I also feel that the other families won't just watch Uncle Zimmerman—and the recently risen Cecht FABN—occupy the leadership position. The interior of the Financial Conglomerate is not that stable.
column2: Cecht FABN belakangan ini sangat mulus, tapi aku juga merasa keluarga lain tidak akan diam melihat Uncle Zimmerman—dan Cecht FABN yang baru naik—menguasai kursi pimpinan. Bagian dalam konglomerat tidak sestabil itu.

column1: So, this time, I plan to follow the winning side, not to mention... he also did me a favor.
column2: Jadi kali ini aku berniat ikut pihak yang menang, apalagi... dia juga pernah menolongku.

column1: (Karl's decisiveness made George raise his eyebrows. Although he didn't have a good impression of this young man, compared to himself who had been struggling in the Yellow Zone, his views on the internal affairs of the Financial Conglomerate and the URNC would undoubtedly be more accurate.)
column2: (Ketegasan Karl membuat George mengangkat kedua alisnya. Meski kesannya terhadap pemuda ini tidak bagus, dibanding dirinya yang selama ini bergulat di Yellow Zone, pandangan Karl soal urusan internal konglomerat dan URNC pasti lebih akurat.)

column1: (Overthinking triggered hunger signals in his stomach. George casually picked up a pack of snacks from the ground and tore open the packaging.)
column2: (Terlalu banyak berpikir memicu sinyal lapar di perutnya. George sekenanya memungut sebungkus jajanan dari lantai dan merobek bungkusnya.)

column1: <size=28>Wait a minute, that's the last pack of mint egg rolls, it's mine!</size>
column2: <size=28>Eh tunggu, itu bungkus terakhir egg roll mint, itu punyaku!</size>

column1: Yeah, but it's in your Uncle George's hands now—hey, put the gun down, put the gun down!
column2: Iya, tapi sekarang sudah ada di tangan Uncle George—hei, turunkan pistolnya, turunkan!

column1: <size=28>No, who doesn't have one?</size>
column2: <size=28>Tidak mau, memangnya siapa yang tidak punya pistol?</size>

column1: Just for a pack of egg rolls, are you a kid?! Put the gun down!
column2: Cuma gara-gara sebungkus egg roll, kau anak kecil?! Turunkan pistolnya!

column1: (Taut nerves and days of pressure forced the two into a tense standoff, even forgetting to lower their voices.)
column2: (Saraf yang tegang dan tekanan berhari-hari mendorong keduanya ke adu nyali yang menegangkan, sampai lupa mengecilkan suara.)

column1: (For a pack of snacks they would usually disdain, the two were now facing off with guns, and it took immense willpower to restrain the urge to shoot each other.)
column2: (Demi sebungkus jajanan yang biasanya mereka pandang remeh, keduanya kini saling todong pistol, dan butuh kemauan sangat besar untuk menahan dorongan menembak satu sama lain.)

column1: (And just before everything got out of hand, there was a knock on the door of the safe house.)
column2: (Dan tepat sebelum semuanya lepas kendali, terdengar ketukan di pintu safe house.)

column1: (It's the signal they agreed upon.)
column2: (Itu kode yang mereka sepakati.)

column1: (The two glared at each other, quickly put away their weapons, and opened the door.)
column2: (Keduanya saling melotot, cepat-cepat menyimpan senjata, lalu membuka pintu.)

column1: Finally waited for you guys to come, how are the arrangements?
column2: Akhirnya kalian datang juga, bagaimana persiapannya?

column1: No way, your names are already all over the streets. Everyone knows someone's paying top dollar for your lives. We ain't got a car for you to flee in now.
column2: Nggak bisa, nama kalian sudah tersebar di seluruh jalanan. Semua orang tahu ada yang bayar mahal untuk nyawa kalian. Sekarang kami nggak punya mobil buat kalian kabur.

column1: (Hearing the disappointing news, Karl's hand didn't leave the gun stock on his waist for a moment, and George didn't stop him.)
column2: (Mendengar kabar yang mengecewakan itu, tangan Karl tidak lepas sedetik pun dari popor pistol di pinggangnya, dan George tidak menghentikannya.)

column1: (After quickly weighing the pros and cons, he glanced at the number of subordinates the other party had brought, and then asked his next question.)
column2: (Setelah cepat menimbang untung-ruginya, dia melirik jumlah anak buah yang dibawa pihak itu, lalu melempar pertanyaan berikutnya.)

column1: Are we still okay?
column2: Kami masih aman?

column1: We don't want to deal with the financial conglomerate, so we'll pass on making this money.
column2: Kami nggak mau berurusan dengan konglomerat finansial, jadi duit ini kami lewatkan saja.

column1: However, we won't refund the money you gave either. You're on your own, take care.
column2: Tapi uang yang kalian setor juga nggak kami kembalikan. Urus sendiri, hati-hati ya.

column1: That won't do! Since you took the money, you have to fulfill the contract!
column2: Tidak bisa begitu! Kalian sudah ambil uangnya, kalian harus penuhi kontraknya!

column1: (Without waiting for George to speak, Karl, who seemed to have suffered a lot these past few days, raised his gun and pointed it at the leading gangster.)
column2: (Tanpa menunggu George bicara, Karl yang sepertinya sudah banyak menderita beberapa hari ini mengangkat pistolnya dan menodongkannya ke pemimpin gangster itu.)

column1: (For a moment, George wanted to cover his face, but he still stood between the two, trying to calm the impending conflict.)
column2: (Sesaat George ingin menutupi wajahnya, tapi dia tetap berdiri di antara keduanya, berusaha meredam konflik yang mau meledak.)

column1: Alright, alright—we don't need to—
column2: Sudah, sudah—kita tidak perlu—

column1: (His action was ultimately half a beat too late. The gang leader sneered, and instantly several guns appeared behind him, aimed at George's head.)
column2: (Tindakannya akhirnya setengah ketukan terlambat. Pemimpin gang itu mendengus mencemooh, dan seketika beberapa pucuk pistol muncul di belakangnya, terarah ke kepala George.)

column1: It seems that even if we don't want to earn, someone will force us to earn...
column2: Kelihatannya meski kami nggak mau cari untung, ada yang memaksa kami cari untung...

column1: Joke, if you don't want to make money, can't you sell the opportunity to make money?
column2: Lucu, kalau nggak mau cari duit, apa nggak bisa jual peluang cari duitnya?

column1: He's not wrong about that... How about it? What if we add a little extra from our savings, and you finish the job anyway?
column2: Dia tidak salah soal itu... Bagaimana? Kalau kami tambah sedikit dari tabungan, kalian tetap selesaikan pekerjaannya?

column1: If it can't be done, it can't be done. Since you're already out of options...
column2: Kalau nggak bisa ya nggak bisa. Karena kalian sudah kehabisan pilihan...

column1: (Before the gangster could finish his sentence, a blossom of blood abruptly bloomed on his temple.)
column2: (Sebelum gangster itu menyelesaikan kalimatnya, kembang darah tiba-tiba merekah di pelipisnya.)

column1: (George desperately throws down his gun, turns around, and pulls Karl down—conveniently using him as a shield over himself.)
column2: (George buru-buru melempar pistolnya, berbalik, dan menarik Karl ke bawah—sekalian memakainya sebagai tameng di atas tubuhnya.)

column1: (The sound of crossfire rings out for only a few seconds before the gang members standing at the door completely fall. In George's ears, he hears a familiar sound—the heavy, mechanized footsteps of a Tactical Doll. A chill envelops his body as he looks at Karl, only to find the latter struggling to crawl toward the window and jumping out.)
column2: (Suara tembak-menembak hanya berlangsung beberapa detik sebelum anggota gang yang berdiri di pintu tumbang semua. Di telinga George terdengar suara yang dia kenal—langkah berat mekanis seekor Tactical Doll. Rasa dingin menyelimuti tubuhnya saat dia menoleh ke Karl, hanya untuk melihat pemuda itu merangkak susah payah ke jendela lalu melompat keluar.)

column1: (George has no other choice.)
column2: (George tidak punya pilihan lain.)

column1: (They almost break their feet from the fall, but still manage to muster the strength to run for their lives. However, George catches a glimpse of the murderer who killed the gang members—)
column2: (Kaki mereka nyaris patah karena jatuh, tapi mereka masih bisa mengumpulkan tenaga untuk kabur menyelamatkan nyawa. Namun George sempat melihat sekilas pembunuh anggota gang itu—)

column1: (Those were exactly the security management Dolls in this satellite city. Obviously, they had all unsealed lethal firepower, and didn't care about casualties in the process.)
column2: (Itu tepatnya Doll pengelola keamanan di kota satelit ini. Jelas semuanya sudah membuka segel daya tembak mematikan, dan tidak peduli soal korban di prosesnya.)

column1: It seems Mr. Zimmerman is indeed a bit anxious this time...
column2: Sepertinya Mr. Zimmerman kali ini memang sedikit tidak sabar...

column1: Stop talking nonsense, quickly think about what to do next!
column2: Berhenti ngomong tidak jelas, cepat pikirkan langkah selanjutnya!

column1: On the other side of this satellite city, I have another safe house. Do you have a way to get a car!
column2: Di sisi lain kota satelit ini aku punya safe house lagi. Kau punya cara dapat mobil!

column1: Well... let's go with Plan B.
column2: Yah... kita pakai Plan B.

column1: When did we have a Plan B!?
column2: Sejak kapan kita punya Plan B!?

column1: Just now.
column2: Baru saja.

column1: (An off-road vehicle knocked away a trash can by the roadside, drifting to a stop in front of them with deep ruts. The door opened directly, and a fierce-looking young man leaned out and looked at them.)
column2: (Sebuah mobil off-road menghantam tong sampah di tepi jalan, mengepot berhenti di depan mereka dengan jejak roda dalam. Pintunya langsung terbuka, dan seorang pemuda berwajah galak menjulurkan kepala menatap mereka.)

column1: Get in.
column2: Masuk.

column1: (The off-road vehicle sped away rapidly, shaking off the pursuing police cars, and undoubtedly leaving behind countless violation records.)
column2: (Mobil off-road itu melesat menjauh, melepaskan diri dari mobil polisi yang mengejar, dan pasti meninggalkan catatan pelanggaran tak terhitung.)

column1: (Paweł displayed rough but effective driving skills, savagely crashing through a series of obstacles along the way. The two, who didn't have time to fasten their seatbelts, were tossed around like they were in a blender, even bumping their foreheads against each other and getting concussions.)
column2: (Paweł memperlihatkan kemampuan menyetir yang kasar tapi efektif, menghajar serangkaian penghalang di sepanjang jalan. Keduanya yang tidak sempat memasang sabuk pengaman terguncang seperti di dalam blender, sampai dahi mereka saling benturan dan gegar otak.)

column1: Damn it... driving like this, you'll kill someone.
column2: Sialan... nyetir seperti ini, kau bisa membunuh orang.

column1: You're not dead, are you?
column2: Kau belum mati, kan?

column1: What are you here for!
column2: Kau datang untuk apa!

column1: To save you, didn't you notice?
column2: Menyelamatkan kalian, tidak kelihatan?

column1: (Karl covers his bleeding nose and looks at George in dismay. Both of them have only met Paweł once, and never imagined he would take such a big risk for them.)
column2: (Karl menutup hidungnya yang berdarah dan menatap George dengan bingung. Keduanya baru sekali bertemu Paweł, dan tidak pernah membayangkan dia mau mengambil risiko sebesar itu untuk mereka.)

column1: It's not that we don't know how to be grateful... but since when did our relationship progress to this point?
column2: Bukannya kami tidak tahu berterima kasih... tapi sejak kapan hubungan kita sampai sejauh ini?

column1: I'm just following her arrangements. If you have any questions, talk to her—
column2: Aku cuma menjalankan aturannya. Kalau ada pertanyaan, bicara dengan dia—

column1: (After speaking, Paweł presses the dashboard, and a projection familiar to both of them appears before their eyes.)
column2: (Setelah bicara, Paweł menekan dasbor, dan proyeksi yang mereka berdua kenal muncul di depan mata.)

column1: (Compared to the last time they met, although she still appeared confident this time, one could see through the sense of brokenness and unease beneath her bravado.)
column2: (Dibanding pertemuan terakhir, meski kali ini dia tetap tampak percaya diri, rasa rapuh dan gelisah di bawah keberaniannya yang dipaksakan itu terbaca.)

column1: (Agatha clenched her fists and shouted at them somewhat uncontrollably and aggressively.)
column2: (Agatha mengepalkan tangan dan berteriak ke arah mereka dengan agak lepas kendali dan agresif.)

column1: Assemble—
column2: Kumpul—

column1: That's great, so you're all still alive.
column2: Bagus sekali, jadi kalian semua masih hidup.

column1: We almost died. Where have you been all this time!?
column2: Kami hampir mati. Kau ke mana saja selama ini!?

column1: An i-important undercover mission... To be honest, even I felt like I almost couldn't hold on. Do you know how I've been these past few days...
column2: M-misi penyusupan penting... Sejujurnya, aku sendiri merasa hampir tidak sanggup. Kalian tahu bagaimana keadaanku beberapa hari ini...

column1: F-Forget it! Anyway, I'm back, don't worry, everything is within calculations.
column2: S-sudahlah! Pokoknya aku sudah kembali, tenang saja, semuanya masih dalam perhitungan.

column1: Calculations my ass! We didn't even say anything, why were we targeted!?
column2: Perhitungan apanya! Kami bahkan belum bicara apa pun, kenapa kami jadi sasaran!?

column1: Yeah, why?
column2: Iya, kenapa?

column1: Because the conglomerate has already infiltrated the decision-making core of the URNC, and controls all of our actions, which naturally includes your testimony framing Zimmerman for all the bad things you've done.
column2: Karena konglomerat sudah menyusup ke inti pengambilan keputusan URNC, dan mengontrol semua gerakan kita, termasuk tentu saja kesaksian kalian yang menimpakan semua perbuatan buruk kalian ke Zimmerman.

column1: Wow, now someone is really dead meat.
column2: Wah, sekarang ada yang benar-benar habis.

column1: Don't worry, this is actually an opportunity for us.
column2: Tenang, ini justru peluang bagi kita.

column1: The people capable of testifying against Zimmerman and the FABN are rapidly decreasing. The price for your heads will naturally go up accordingly.
column2: Orang yang sanggup bersaksi melawan Zimmerman dan FABN makin sedikit dengan cepat. Harga kepala kalian otomatis akan ikut naik.

column1: Reinforcements will soon go to meet up with you, but before that, can you answer me—
column2: Bantuan akan segera menyusul kalian, tapi sebelum itu, bisa jawab pertanyaanku—

column1: Who has heard of "Lullaby"?
column2: Siapa yang pernah mendengar "Lullaby"?
